{{Top|leg}}
'''Crystalline lumens''' were a form of lighting used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. They were usually set on tall, gracefully designed poles. The [[thinking gardens]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]] were lit by crystalline lumens at night.
